make_dataset: create a fairseq indexed dataset from a given path and implementation type like mmap or cached
make_builder: build an mmap or lazy indexed dataset builder for writing tensor data to disk
infer_dataset_impl: infer the dataset implementation type from an existing dataset path by reading its index header
MMapIndexedDatasetBuilder_add_item: add a torch tensor item to an mmap indexed dataset builder before finalizing
MMapIndexedDataset_getitem: retrieve a tensor by index from a memory-mapped indexed dataset using numpy memmap
